zh: 第三方分享剪藏能力增强，支持直接剪藏内容、小红书视频与公众号文章。
笔记详情页支持双击进入编辑，长文阅读、随机漫步定位信息与工具栏选项继续完善。
修复图片预览黑屏、探索界面输入框显示异常、AI 摘要崩溃与附件同步等问题。
en: Expanded share clipping so content, Xiaohongshu videos, and WeChat articles can be captured more directly.
Note details now support double-tap editing, with more polish for long-form reading, location info in Random Walk, and toolbar options.
Fixed the image preview black screen, the missing Explore input field, AI summary crashes, and several attachment sync issues.

zh: 第三方分享支持直接剪藏内容
增强第三方分享剪藏，并支持清洗公众号文章
笔记详情页支持双击进入编辑
en: Third-party sharing now supports direct content clipping.
Enhanced share clipping and article cleanup for WeChat content.
Double-tap note details to enter editing.

zh: 随机漫步补充位置信息
继续完善公众号文章清洗
en: Random Walk now carries location information.
Further improved article cleanup for public account content.

zh: 修复图片预览黑屏故障
修复探索界面输入框无法显示的问题
防止 AI 摘要在未对齐的嵌入 blob 上崩溃
en: Fixed the image preview black screen.
Fixed the missing input field on the Explore screen.
Prevented AI summary crashes on misaligned embedded blobs.
